alerts.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.
alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set

alerts.description: The response does not include an X-Frame-Options header to protect against 'ClickJacking' attacks.
alerts.solution: Most modern Web browsers support the X-Frame-Options HTTP header. Ensure it's set on all web pages returned by your site.
alerts.name: Anti-clickjacking Header (X-Frame-Options) Not Set

alerts.description: A cookie has been set without the HttpOnly flag, which permits the cookie to be accessed by client-side scripts.
alerts.solution: Ensure that the HttpOnly flag is set for all cookies.
alerts.name: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag

alerts.description: The web/application server is leaking version information via the 'Server' HTTP response header.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server is configured to conceal its identity and version.
alerts.alert: Server Leaks Information via 'Server' HTTP Response Header Field
alerts.name: Server Leaks Information via 'Server' HTTP Response Header Field

alerts.description: A backup archive or directory listing was found on the server.
alerts.solution: Disable directory indexing and delete backup files from the public web server.
alerts.name: Directory Browsing / Backup Disclosure
